product_one_liner.value: Gushwork uses AI marketing agents to help small and midsized businesses, particularly manufacturers, industrial distributors and commercial-service providers, get discovered across AI search, Google and paid channels and generate qualified inbound leads.

employee_band.notes: Published company profiles report 203 and 202 employees respectively; the band uses those counts rather than the older approximately 90-person description in job postings.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index covers marketing, SEO, AI search and lead generation; it does not establish two engineering-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No public documentation or help-center link was found in the site navigation/footer; the public blog and service FAQs are marketing content, not a multi-article product documentation portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists Forward Deployed Engineer, Implementation Engineer and Talent Acquisition Partner – GTM. None has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title; AI-related responsibilities alone were not counted.

model_provider.notes: In a February 26, 2026 interview, the CEO explicitly said Gushwork uses Anthropic models heavily and also uses OpenAI models.

compliance_certs.notes: No claim to any of the five requested certifications was found. GDPR legal-basis disclosures in the privacy policy were not treated as certification.

last_funding.notes: The company announced the round on February 26, 2026; the funding database dates it February 25, 2026. Both establish February 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The February 2026 seed round falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Readable SDR and Account Executive postings exist, and the SDR application page accepts applications, although these roles are not displayed on the unfiltered careers-board snapshot.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 2, 2026, Gushwork launched AI Editor for all customers: a new dashboard workflow to edit published landing pages using plain-English prompts, review changes and revert them. This falls within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level arrival or departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The careers page is not a complete leadership roster; the verified CTO start date is April 2025, outside the window, so it cannot establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are job-posting signals, not proof of an exclusive deployed stack: postings request familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce and Justcall, list Zoho among CRM examples, and name Aircall/PhoneBurner as dialer experience.
